dedupe_keys.name: mexico educational physical infrastructure register inifed

description: Secretaría de Educación Pública (SEP), with data of the Instituto Nacional de la Infraestructura Física Educativa (INIFED) publishes data of the national institute for educational physical infrastructure (INIFED) on the construction, equipment, maintenance, rehabilitation and installations of public education, with a register of educational physical infrastructure published for 2013 and 2020. Coverage: Mexico nationwide; register files for 2013 and 2020, with the portal record created on 2025-03-14 and last modified on 2026-08-27. Format and access: CSV, downloadable without registration from the Mexican open data portal (datos.gob.mx); the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; cost: free. Caveats: the two register files are five years or more apart and were not opened, so the schema, the school count and whether there is one row per school or per building are unconfirmed. Simulation uses: school-building condition and capacity inputs for seismic and flood exposure analyses, and rehabilitation-prioritisation models. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
name: Mexico: educational physical infrastructure register (INIFED)
notes: Round 2 piece 14 (no-public-data visits): round 1 marked "datos.gob.mx (urban observatory)" as publishing no data; the portal was read on 2026-09-29.
